sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我在《纽约时报》的每日简报 DealBook 负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的舞台上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上免费直播部分精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: In seeking accountability for the opioid epidemic, prosecutors have been targeting the bottom rung, users themselves.
sentences.zh: 在为阿片类药物泛滥寻求问责时，检察官们一直将目标锁定在底层，即药物使用者本身。

sentences.en: But the family who made billions off the sales of the painkiller at the center of the epidemic has gone largely unpunished.
sentences.zh: 但那个通过销售处于疫情中心的止痛药赚取了数十亿美元的家族，却基本未受惩罚。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月5日，星期四。

sentences.en: There were three Sackler brothers.
sentences.zh: 萨克勒家族有三兄弟。

sentences.en: There was Arthur, Mortimer, and Raymond.
sentences.zh: 分别是亚瑟、莫蒂默和雷蒙德。

sentences.en: They all grew up in New York City.
sentences.zh: 他们都在纽约市长大。

sentences.en: They were from Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 他们来自布鲁克林。

sentences.en: Their parents were immigrants, and they all eventually went to medical school and were trained as research psychiatrists.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母是移民，三兄弟最终都上了医学院，并接受了精神病学研究的培训。

sentences.en: Barry Meyer has reported on the origin of the opioid epidemic for The Times.
sentences.zh: 巴里·迈尔斯为《纽约时报》报道了阿片类药物危机的起源。

sentences.en: Arthur, the older brother, even while he was in medical training, worked part-time as a copywriter in an advertising company that specialized in advertising prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 老大亚瑟甚至在接受医学培训期间，就在一家专门从事处方药广告的广告公司兼职担任文案。

sentences.en: And right around this time, which was not long after the end of World War II, the pharmaceutical industry itself was exploding.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候——也就是第二次世界大战结束不久后——制药行业本身迎来了爆发式增长。

sentences.en: Companies were growing.
sentences.zh: 公司在不断发展。

sentences.en: They were producing more types of drugs, lots of different antibiotics, for example.
sentences.zh: 他们生产更多种类的药物，例如许多不同的抗生素。

sentences.en: And Arthur discovered he's got a real knack for this.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟发现自己在这一领域非常有天赋。

sentences.en: One of the more infamous ads that he created was an ad for an antibiotic.
sentences.zh: 他创作的更具恶名的广告之一是一则抗生素广告。

sentences.en: And it was essentially a testimonial where you had doctors testifying about what a great drug it was.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一则见证广告，由医生们出面证明这是一种多么伟大的药物。

sentences.en: And subsequently, when people started checking on the whereabouts of these doctors, they found out that these doctors didn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 随后，当人们开始核查这些医生的下落时，却发现这些医生根本不存在。

sentences.en: He just made them up.
sentences.zh: 他完全是凭空捏造的。

sentences.en: He totally made them up.
sentences.zh: 他完全是编造出来的。

sentences.en: But it became sort of a hallmark.
sentences.zh: 但这成了一种标志性的作风。

sentences.en: You know, this is the kind of stuff that Arthur Sackler did.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是亚瑟·萨克勒会做的那种事。

sentences.en: Arthur is making a fortune from the advertising and marketing of drugs.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟通过药品的广告和营销赚取了巨额财富。

sentences.en: But there's one area where he wants to make another fortune, and that is in the production and sale of drugs themselves.
sentences.zh: 但还有一个领域他想再赚一笔财富，那就是药品的生产和销售本身。

sentences.en: So he brings in his brothers, Mortimer and Raymond.
sentences.zh: 于是他把他的兄弟莫蒂默和雷蒙德也拉了进来。

sentences.en: And they purchase a company that becomes known as Purdue Pharma.
sentences.zh: 他们收购了一家公司，也就是后来为人所知的普渡制药。

sentences.en: And what does this company that they buy, Purdue Pharma, what does it actually sell?
sentences.zh: 他们收购的这家公司——普渡制药，实际上卖的是什么？

sentences.en: The first products they sell are basically a laxative.
sentences.zh: 他们卖的第一批产品基本上是泻药。

sentences.en: Then they move on to an earwax softener.
sentences.zh: 接着他们转向了耳垢软化剂。

sentences.en: It's in the 1980s that they start selling their first real drug.
sentences.zh: 正是在20世纪80年代，他们开始销售真正意义上的第一款药物。

sentences.en: It's a drug that is supposed to treat the most severe types of pain, like cancer pain, called MS-Contin.
sentences.zh: 这是一种旨在治疗最严重疼痛（如癌症疼痛）的药物，名为美施康定（MS-Contin）。

sentences.en: And essentially what it is, it's pure morphine in a tablet form.
sentences.zh: 本质上，它就是片剂形式的纯吗啡。

sentences.en: Barry, how did the company go from earwax remover to pure morphine?
sentences.zh: 巴里，公司是怎么从耳垢清除剂跨越到纯吗啡的？

sentences.en: That's a huge leap.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的飞跃。

sentences.en: Well, the Sacklers were adept at catching moments.
sentences.zh: 嗯，萨克勒兄弟很擅长捕捉时机。

sentences.en: And the 1980s was one of them, particularly when it came to the treatment of pain.
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代就是其中之一，特别是在疼痛治疗方面。

sentences.en: For years, there had been resistance to the use of narcotics to treat pain, even for patients who were suffering from cancer or who were at the end of their lives.
sentences.zh: 多年来，人们一直抗拒使用麻醉剂来治疗疼痛，甚至对癌症患者或生命垂危的患者也是如此。

sentences.en: There was, you know, fears of addiction, that these patients would abuse the drug.
sentences.zh: 当时你知道的，人们担心会上瘾，担心这些患者会滥用药物。

sentences.en: A special documentary report on the topic of cancer pain.
sentences.zh: 关于癌症疼痛主题的专题纪录片报道。

sentences.en: But by the 1980s, cancer patients sometimes suffer needless pain.
sentences.zh: 但到了20世纪80年代，癌症患者有时会遭受不必要的痛苦。

sentences.en: They suffer not because pain relief is impossible, but because we are sometimes more focused on that elusive cure than on compassion.
sentences.zh: 他们受苦不是因为无法缓解疼痛，而是因为我们有时更关注难以捉摸的治愈，而不是同情心。

sentences.en: People wanted to be compassionate.
sentences.zh: 人们希望展现同情心。

sentences.en: People wanted to deal with this type of patient pain.
sentences.zh: 人们希望应对患者的这种痛苦。

sentences.en: And MS-Contin, which was a long-acting form of morphine that Purdue started producing, kind of arrived at this moment.
sentences.zh: 而普渡制药开始生产的长效吗啡美施康定，正是在这个时候应运而生。

sentences.en: And doctors embraced it as an effective way of treating patients at the end of life.
sentences.zh: 医生们将其视为临终关怀中治疗患者的有效方法，并予以接受。

sentences.en: That compassionate approach to pain treatment soon jumped over the walls of the cancer wards into the mainstream of medicine.
sentences.zh: 这种富有同情心的疼痛治疗方法很快走出了癌症病房，进入了主流医学界。

sentences.en: As advocates for greater narcotics use began promoting the use of these drugs for all kinds of common pain, be it back pain, arthritis, dental pain, you name it.
sentences.zh: 随着更多麻醉剂使用的倡导者开始推广这些药物来治疗各种常见疼痛，无论是背痛、关节炎、牙痛，应有尽有。

sentences.en: Basically pointing back to the experience with cancer patients, saying, it was so successful here, why are we preventing patients from getting these kinds of drugs?
sentences.zh: 基本上是以癌症患者的治疗经验为例，说道，既然在这里如此成功，为什么我们要阻止患者获得这类药物？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And it would seem that Purdue Pharma would be well-positioned for that.
sentences.zh: 看来普渡制药已经为此做好了充分的准备。

sentences.en: They were perfectly positioned because right around the time that this movement was making the transition from the cancer ward into the general breadbasket of medicine,
sentences.zh: 他们做好了完美的准备，因为就在这场运动从癌症病房向普通医学领域过渡之际，

sentences.en: they were developing a drug that would become the flagship drug of the pain management movement.
sentences.zh: 他们正在研发一种将成为疼痛管理运动旗舰产品的药物。

sentences.en: And that drug was called OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 这种药叫做奥施康定（OxyContin）。

sentences.en: OxyContin was a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 奥施康定就像一颗核武器。

sentences.en: It contained large amounts of a narcotic called OxyContin, which is part of the opioid family of drugs, which also includes heroin and morphine.
sentences.zh: 它含有大量名为羟考酮的麻醉剂，该成分属于阿片类药物家族，海洛因和吗啡也在此列。

sentences.en: So it was a pure, powerful narcotic that was many, many times stronger than any pain reliever that had preceded it on the market.
sentences.zh: 所以它是一种纯净、强效的麻醉剂，比市场上以往任何止痛药都要强大许多倍。

sentences.en: It seems like it would be very hard to get such a powerful drug, the nuclear narcotic, as you described it, past federal regulators.
sentences.zh: 听起来要让这样一种强效药物——正如你所描述的核级麻醉剂——通过联邦监管机构的审批应该非常困难。

sentences.en: Well, Sackler's came up and Purdue came up with a brilliant strategy based on the nature of OxyContin itself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，萨克勒家族和普渡制药根据奥施康定本身的特性，想出了一种绝妙的策略。

sentences.en: Traditional narcotic painkillers, drugs like Percocet and Vicodin, last for four hours.
sentences.zh: 传统的麻醉性止痛药，如扑热息痛复方药和维柯丁，药效持续四个小时。

sentences.en: OxyContin lasts for 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 奥施康定则可持续12小时。

sentences.en: The content in OxyContin stands for continuous.
sentences.zh: 奥施康定（OxyContin）中的名字正代表着持续（continuous）。

sentences.en: So OxyContin was essentially a long-acting version of a painkiller.
sentences.zh: 因此，奥施康定本质上是长效版的止痛药。

sentences.en: And the concept that Purdue presented to the FDA was simply this.
sentences.zh: 普渡向美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）提出的概念非常简单。

sentences.en: Because it was a long-acting narcotic, it would have less appeal to people who like to abuse painkillers because they like to get a quick hit from a drug.
sentences.zh: 由于它是一种长效麻醉剂，对于那些喜欢通过药物快速获得快感、因而喜欢滥用止痛药的人来说，它的吸引力会更小。

sentences.en: So they'd be looking for drugs like Percocet or Vicodin, which acted more quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会寻找像扑热息痛复方药或维柯丁那样起效更快的药物。

sentences.en: And they could get their hit from it more immediately than they could from OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 并且他们能从中比从奥施康定那里更直接地获得快感。

sentences.en: And in late 1995, the FDA approves OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 1995年底，FDA批准了奥施康定。

sentences.en: And as part of that approval, they give Purdue a unique marketing claim that the regulators had never given to any pharmaceutical company before.
sentences.zh: 作为批准的一部分，他们赋予了普渡一项独特的营销声明，这是监管机构以前从未给过任何制药公司的。

sentences.en: And that is the claim that essentially says that OxyContin, because it is a long-acting narcotic,
sentences.zh: 也就是基本上声称奥施康定由于是一种长效麻醉剂，

sentences.en: is believed to pose less of a risk for abuse and addiction than traditional opioids.
sentences.zh: 据信与传统阿片类药物相比，其滥用和成瘾风险更低。

sentences.en: So Purdue creates this drug, OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 于是普渡创造了这种药物——奥施康定。

sentences.en: The FDA approves it.
sentences.zh: FDA批准了它。

sentences.en: And it gives the company this kind of soft, ambiguous claim that the drug is believed to be less addictive than other narcotics.
sentences.zh: 并给予该公司一种温和、含糊的声明，即据信该药比其他麻醉剂更不易成瘾。

sentences.en: And then what happens?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Essentially, they take what is an equivocal claim and they turn it into an absolute claim.
sentences.zh: 本质上，他们将一个模棱两可的声明变成了一个绝对化的声明。

sentences.en: We doctors were wrong in thinking that opioids can't be used long-term.
sentences.zh: 我们医生以前认为阿片类药物不能长期使用的是错误的。

sentences.en: So they train their salespeople to go out to doctors and tell doctors that OxyContin will not cause abuse and addiction.
sentences.zh: 于是他们培训销售人员去见医生，告诉医生奥施康定不会导致滥用和成瘾。

sentences.en: We used to think they'd stop working or the patients would become addicts.
sentences.zh: 我们过去认为它们会失效，或者患者会成瘾。

sentences.en: That it's a totally unique drug, a safer drug, a better drug.
sentences.zh: 这是一种完全独特的药物，更安全，更好。

sentences.en: We now find that these medicines are much safer, much more powerful, much more versatile than we used to think.
sentences.zh: 我们现在发现这些药物比我们过去认为的要安全得多、强大得多、多功能得多。

sentences.en: And we feel that they should be used much more liberally for people with all sorts of chronic pain.
sentences.zh: 我们认为应该更慷慨地将它们用于患有各种慢性疼痛的人。

sentences.en: It goes out and begins holding seminars throughout the country, hundreds of seminars, where it flies in doctors for essentially all-expense-paid junkets at resorts.
sentences.zh: 它开始在全国各地举办研讨会，举办了数百场研讨会，用全额资助的度假村豪华游将医生们用飞机接送过来。

sentences.en: I thought it would be nice to let you know what's going on in my specialty.
sentences.zh: 我想让你们了解一下我所从事的专业领域正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: As you know, I work in pain management.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我从事疼痛管理工作。

sentences.en: Where they're proselytized about the undertreatment of pain and the need to treat pain more aggressively.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们被灌输关于疼痛治疗不足以及需要更积极地治疗疼痛的观念。

sentences.en: We usually undertreat pain.
sentences.zh: 我们通常对疼痛治疗不足。

sentences.en: We undertreat pain catastrophically.
sentences.zh: 我们在灾难性地对疼痛治疗不足。

sentences.en: Very often we don't even recognize it.
sentences.zh: 很多时候我们甚至没有识别出来。

sentences.en: Very often we don't even acknowledge it.
sentences.zh: 很多时候我们甚至没有承认这一点。

sentences.en: We refuse to acknowledge that the patient's hurting.
sentences.zh: 我们拒绝承认患者在痛苦。

sentences.en: Essentially what Purdue is doing is taking what have become standard marketing techniques for everyday common drugs.
sentences.zh: 普渡所做的本质上是采用日常普通药物的标准营销技术。

sentences.en: You know, cholesterol-lowering drugs, diabetes drugs, erectile dysfunction drugs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，降胆固醇药、糖尿病药、勃起功能障碍药。

sentences.en: And it is using these same techniques to promote a high-powered, addictive, narcotic painkiller.
sentences.zh: 它正在使用这些相同的技术来推广一种高强度、易成瘾的麻醉性止痛药。

sentences.en: That had never been done in the history of the pharmaceutical industry before.
sentences.zh: 这在制药行业历史上是从来没有过的。

sentences.en: So does this marketing blitz work?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种营销攻势起作用了吗？

sentences.en: It works incredibly well.
sentences.zh: 效果好得惊人。

sentences.en: Tiny Purdue has turned into a powerhouse.
sentences.zh: 小小的普渡已变成了一家巨头。

sentences.en: And sales of OxyContin are skyrocketing.
sentences.zh: 奥施康定的销量正在飙升。

sentences.en: By the late 1990s, it's bringing in over a billion dollars a year in sales.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪90年代末，其年销售额已超过十亿美元。

sentences.en: This one drug.
sentences.zh: 就靠这一种药。

sentences.en: This one drug.
sentences.zh: 就靠这一种药。

sentences.en: And this one drug is accounting virtually all of Purdue Pharma's revenues.
sentences.zh: 而这一种药几乎占据了普渡制药的全部收入。

sentences.en: And Barry, how do you become drawn into this story?
sentences.zh: 巴里，你是怎么被卷入这个故事的？

sentences.en: At this time in 2001, I had done a few stories about the drug industry, but I knew nothing about narcotic painkillers, drug addiction,
sentences.zh: 在2001年的这个时候，我做过一些关于制药行业的报道，但我对麻醉性止痛药、药物成瘾一无所知，

sentences.en: and had never heard of Purdue Pharma or the Sacklers ever before.
sentences.zh: 以前也从未听说过普渡制药或萨克勒家族。

sentences.en: But on one day in 2001, an editor comes over to me and says that he's received a call from a source of his, a person who's working for a pharmacy board.
sentences.zh: 但在2001年的某一天，一位编辑走过来对我说，他接到了一位消息人士的电话，那个人在药剂师委员会工作。

sentences.en: And the story he relates is that there's this hot new drug on the street, this pharmaceutical that's being abused, that people are seeking, that's getting top dollar on the street.
sentences.zh: 他讲述的故事是，街头出现了一种热门新药，这种正被滥用的药品备受人们追捧，在街头能卖出高价。

sentences.en: And what makes the situation particularly extraordinary is that Purdue Pharma is going around promoting this drug, OxyContin, as less prone to abuse and addiction.
sentences.zh: 而使这种情况尤为不同寻常的是，普渡制药到处宣传这种名为奥施康定的药物不易滥用和成瘾。

sentences.en: So the editor says to me, well, why don't you start making phone calls and try to figure out what's going on here?
sentences.zh: 于是编辑对我说，你为什么不开始打电话，弄清楚这里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: And what did you hear when you started to make those calls?
sentences.zh: 当你开始打那些电话时，你听到了什么？

sentences.en: What I start finding out is that it's known as OxyContin, Oxy or hillbilly heroin.
sentences.zh: 我开始发现它被称为奥施康定、Oxy 或者是山民海洛因（hillbilly heroin）。

sentences.en: All that was needed was to basically pop this drug in your mouth and the entire narcotic payload that was contained within an OxyContin would be available for your immediate use.
sentences.zh: 所需要做的基本上就是把这药放进嘴里，奥施康定中所包含的全部麻醉成分就会释放出来，供你立即使用。

sentences.en: Thefts of a drug, some say, can cause a high like heroin.
sentences.zh: 有人说，药物盗窃可以带来像海洛因一样的快感。

sentences.en: And OxyContin is becoming the core and the leading edge of a crime wave.
sentences.zh: 奥施康定正成为犯罪浪潮的核心和前沿。

sentences.en: Prescription holders have been assaulted.
sentences.zh: 持有处方的人遭到袭击。

sentences.en: Addicts have faked pain to get prescriptions.
sentences.zh: 瘾君子伪装疼痛以获取处方。

sentences.en: And around the country, there have been more than 700 pharmacy robberies like this one.
sentences.zh: 在全国各地，发生了700多起像这样的药房抢劫案。

sentences.en: According to police, he gives a note to the pharmacist telling them to hand over all their OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 据警方称，他递给药剂师一张纸条，叫他们交出所有的奥施康定。

sentences.en: People are breaking into drugstores to steal OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 人们闯入药店偷窃奥施康定。

sentences.en: They're breaking into people's homes to steal OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 他们闯入别人家中偷窃奥施康定。

sentences.en: They're shoplifting things to get the money to buy OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 他们通过顺手牵羊来筹钱购买奥施康定。

sentences.en: It was being sold for, you know, $20, $40, $80 on the street for a tablet of OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 一片奥施康定在街头被以20美元、40美元、80美元的价格出售。

sentences.en: For one pill.
sentences.zh: 就为了一粒药片。

sentences.en: For one pill that you could get by prescription for like a dollar or two.
sentences.zh: 就为了那一粒你只需花一两美元就能凭处方买到的药片。

sentences.en: It becomes clear to me fairly soon, maybe after a few months of reporting, that the basic claims that are being made by Purdue are not accurate.
sentences.zh: 经过几个月的报道，我很快清楚地认识到，普渡所做出的基本声明并不准确。

sentences.en: That the science behind those claims doesn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 支持这些声明的科学依据并不存在。

sentences.en: And what I'm starting to observe is the coming together of a huge public health crisis.
sentences.zh: 我开始观察到一场巨大的公共卫生危机正在汇聚。

sentences.en: By the time emergency workers brought Shauna to the hospital, she was dead of an OxyContin overdose.
sentences.zh: 当急救人员将肖娜送到医院时，她已经因过量服用奥施康定而死亡。

sentences.en: About a hundred of the cases that we see every year now are OxyContin deaths.
sentences.zh: 现在我们每年看到的案例中，大约有一百起是奥施康定致死案。

sentences.en: And about half of those are OxyContin related deaths.
sentences.zh: 其中大约一半是与奥施康定相关的死亡。

sentences.en: But federal drug authorities are increasingly concerned about the dangers to unsuspecting kids who take the pills as a party drug, having no idea what they're in for.
sentences.zh: 但联邦缉毒当局越来越担心，那些把药当成派对药物、完全不知道会有什么后果的毫无戒心的孩子们会面临危险。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是《纽约时报》的订阅用户，请立即下载时报App，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: The next panel will be Dr. Paul Goldenheim, Executive Vice President for Research and Development of Regulatory and Medical Affairs, Purdue Pharma.
sentences.zh: 接下来的专家小组是保真制药公司研究与开发、监管与医疗事务执行副总裁保罗·戈登海姆博士。

sentences.en: In 2001, executives of Purdue Pharma are called before Congress for a series of hearings.
sentences.zh: 2001年，保真制药的高管被传唤到国会参加一系列听证会。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席先生。

sentences.en: The article in yesterday's New York Times.
sentences.zh: 昨天《纽约时报》上的那篇文章。

sentences.en: Now, there are papers and there are newspapers.
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，报纸跟报纸可不一样。

sentences.en: This one has a pretty decent reputation for its analysis of issues.
sentences.zh: 这家报纸在问题分析方面的声誉相当不错。

sentences.en: Are they wrong?
sentences.zh: 难道他们错了吗？

sentences.en: Because they weren't exactly nice to your company at all.
sentences.zh: 因为他们对你们公司可一点也不客气。

sentences.en: Which statement in particular were you referring to, sir?
sentences.zh: 阁下，您具体指的是哪种说法？

sentences.en: It's clear to everyone by now that the abuse of OxyContin is widespread, and one of the questions that lawmakers have is...
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，大家都清楚奥施康定的滥用现象已经非常普遍，而立法者们提出的问题之一就是……

sentences.en: The fact that your salesmen have been approached by pharmacists, for instance, and told that there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 比如，你们的推销员曾被药剂师接触过，并被告知存在问题。

sentences.en: People understood it was all about making money and not necessarily about what the results were.
sentences.zh: 人们明白，这一切都是为了赚钱，而不一定是为了结果如何。

sentences.en: When did the company learn about the drug's abuse and what did it do about it when it learned that information?
sentences.zh: 公司是什么时候得知该药物被滥用的？在获悉这些信息后又采取了什么行动？

sentences.en: And what does the company say in response to that question?
sentences.zh: 公司对这个问题作何回应？

sentences.en: They draw a line in the sand.
sentences.zh: 他们划出了一条底线。

sentences.en: We launched OxyContin in 1996, and for the first four years on the market, we did not hear of any particular problem.
sentences.zh: 我们在1996年推出了奥施康定，在上市的前四年里，我们没有听说过任何特定的问题。

sentences.en: And that is that they only became aware of OxyContin's growing abuse in early 2000.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们直到2000年初才意识到奥施康定的滥用日益严重。

sentences.en: In February of 2000, that was the first time we had any inclination that something different was going on that required special attention.
sentences.zh: 在2000年2月，那是我们第一次察觉到有什么不同寻常的事情正在发生，需要给予特别关注。

sentences.en: And it's a line that they would stick to before Congress, in other public settings, in interviews with the news media.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们将在国会、其他公开场合以及接受新闻媒体采访时一直坚守的立场。

sentences.en: And does anything come of these congressional hearings?
sentences.zh: 这些国会听证会产生了什么结果吗？

sentences.en: On the surface, it appears that that produced weather storm, nothing has really happened to them.
sentences.zh: 表面上看，虽然引发了一场风暴，但他们实际上并没有受到任何实质影响。

sentences.en: But in fact, in this tiny town called Abington, which is in very western Virginia, something has started to happen.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，在这个位于弗吉尼亚州最西部的名为阿宾顿的小镇里，有些事情已经开始发生了。

sentences.en: Abington is the type of town, much like many towns in the Appalachian region, that's been hard hit by OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 阿宾顿是一个典型的城镇，就像阿巴拉契亚地区的许多城镇一样，深受奥施康定的重创。

sentences.en: The prosecutors in this town, every case that they're working on, has become involved with OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 这个镇上的检察官们手头的每一个案件，都与奥施康定扯上了关系。

sentences.en: They're prosecuting doctors, they're prosecuting druggists, they're prosecuting drug abusers.
sentences.zh: 他们在起诉医生，起诉药剂师，起诉药物滥用者。

sentences.en: And eventually, it strikes them that they ought to be looking at the drug's manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们突然意识到，他们应该把目光投向这种药的制造商。

sentences.en: So they launch an investigation of Purdue.
sentences.zh: 于是他们对保真制药展开了调查。

sentences.en: And what do these federal investigators, Barry, find as they're digging into Purdue?
sentences.zh: 巴里，这些联邦调查人员在深入调查保真制药时发现了什么？

sentences.en: Simply put, they find two things.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，他们发现了两件事。

sentences.en: The first thing that they find is that Purdue has engaged in systemic deception of doctors.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的第一件事是，保真制药对医生进行了系统性的欺骗。

sentences.en: They've trained their sales representatives to go out and tell doctors that OxyContin can't be abused, it won't cause addiction.
sentences.zh: 他们训练销售代表外出告诉医生奥施康定不会被滥用，也不会导致成瘾。

sentences.en: Essentially, train them to lie to doctors.
sentences.zh: 本质上，就是训练他们向医生撒谎。

sentences.en: The second thing that prosecutors discover is evidence that company executives were aware of OxyContin's abuse in 1998, three years prior to their testimony.
sentences.zh: 检察官们发现的第二件事是证据，证明公司高管在1998年，即作证三年前就已经知道奥施康定被滥用了。

sentences.en: And that effectively, they covered up their knowledge.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，他们掩盖了自己知情的事实。

sentences.en: So what do these investigators do with these very damning findings?
sentences.zh: 那么这些调查人员对这些非常不利的调查结果做了什么呢？

sentences.en: They prepare a report.
sentences.zh: 他们准备了一份报告。

sentences.en: And within that report are there recommendations for indictments, you know, criminal charges that are going to be brought.
sentences.zh: 在这份报告中，是否有关于起诉的建议，也就是即将提出的刑事指控。

sentences.en: And those recommendations include felony indictments against Purdue Pharma for defrauding the United States government and felony charges against the company's three top operating executives for their roles in that conspiracy to defraud the government.
sentences.zh: 这些建议包括对保真制药公司提出欺诈美国政府的重罪起诉，以及对该公司三位最高运营高管在串谋欺诈政府这一罪行中所起的作用提出重罪指控。

sentences.en: And other charges, including making false statements, lying to Congress, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 以及其他指控，包括作虚假陈述、对国会撒谎等。

sentences.en: So very, very serious charges for which these executives could be sent to prison for any number of years.
sentences.zh: 这些都是非常非常严重的指控，这些高管可能会因此被判处数年监禁。

sentences.en: And these recommendations for charges are now forwarded to the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 这些起诉建议现在已转交给司法部。

sentences.en: And it appears that it's all set to go until the 11th hour.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来一切都已准备就绪，直到最后一刻。

sentences.en: What happened in the 11th hour?
sentences.zh: 最后一刻发生了什么？

sentences.en: So there's an 11th hour meeting between top political appointees within the Justice Department and an all-star defense team that Purdue has assembled.
sentences.zh: 司法部内部的高级政治任命官员与保真制药组建的梦幻辩护团队在最后一刻举行了一场会面。

sentences.en: And that defense team itself is being advised by Rudy Giuliani.
sentences.zh: 而这个辩护团队本身正由鲁迪·朱利安尼担任顾问。

sentences.en: And once this 11th hour meeting is over and the door opens up, it becomes clear to the people who had hoped to bring this indictment that they're not going to be able to do it.
sentences.zh: 一旦这场最后一刻的会面结束，门打开时，那些曾希望提起诉讼的人清楚地意识到，他们将无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: So whatever happened in this meeting resulted in the Department of Justice telling the investigators that these charges were not going to be brought against Purdue and its executives.
sentences.zh: 因此，这次会议无论发生了什么，结果都是司法部告诉调查人员，这些指控不会针对保真制药及其高管提起。

sentences.en: Yes,
sentences.zh: 是的，

sentences.en: the message from the Justice Department was you're going to have to plea bargain and see if you can bring a misdemeanor case or bring lower charges against them because we're not going to support a felony charge.
sentences.zh: 司法部传达的信息是，你们必须进行认罪协商，看看能否对他们提出轻罪指控或较低的指控，因为我们不会支持重罪指控。

sentences.en: Essentially, the message was back off.
sentences.zh: 本质上，传达的信息就是退缩吧。

sentences.en: Essentially, yeah.
sentences.zh: 基本上是的。

sentences.en: The message was this is not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 传达的信息是这不可能发生。

sentences.en: We're not going down this road.
sentences.zh: 我们不会走这条路的。

sentences.en: And so a plea bargain is struck.
sentences.zh: 于是达成了一项认罪协议。

sentences.en: The company itself pled guilty to a charge that it had misrepresented what the FDA had allowed it to say about Oxycontin's potential for abuse and addiction and paid a $600 million fine.
sentences.zh: 该公司本身对一项指控表示认罪，承认其歪曲了FDA允许其宣传的关于奥施康定滥用和成瘾可能性的言论，并支付了6亿美元的罚款。

sentences.en: The executives were allowed to plead guilty to misdemeanor charges.
sentences.zh: 这些高管被允许对轻罪指控认罪。

sentences.en: And the executives would claim both before they pled guilty to these misdemeanors that they did nothing wrong and essentially afterwards would continue to claim that they had done nothing wrong and that effectively the government had not accused them of doing anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 这些高管在承认这些轻罪之前声称自己没有做错任何事，而在本质上事后也将继续声称自己没有做错任何事，并且实际上政府也没有指控他们做错了任何事。

sentences.en: And perhaps the most remarkable part about the resolution of the case in 2007 was the fact that because the indictments never went forward,
sentences.zh: 关于2007年案件最终解决最引人注目的部分，也许是因为起诉从未推进，

sentences.en: all the work that prosecutors had put into compiling their report, all the evidence that they had gathered from Purdue's files,
sentences.zh: 检察官为汇编报告所付出的所有工作，他们从保真制药文件中收集的所有证据，

sentences.en: all the testimony that they had gotten from former company execs during grand jury proceedings got buried.
sentences.zh: 他们在联邦大陪审团诉讼程序中从前公司高管那里获得的所有证词都被掩埋了。

sentences.en: Buried how?
sentences.zh: 怎么被掩埋的？

sentences.en: Well, essentially, it was protected because it was grand jury information.
sentences.zh: 嗯，本质上，它得到了保护，因为这是大陪审团的信息。

sentences.en: The report itself was effectively sealed and buried in Justice Department files, never publicly released.
sentences.zh: 该报告本身实际上被封存并埋藏在司法部的档案中，从未向公众公布。

sentences.en: Someone who was upset that this information had been buried, that the Justice Department had not gone forward with the prosecution, provided me with a copy very recently.
sentences.zh: 有人对这些信息被掩埋、司法部没有推进起诉感到不满，最近将一份副本交给了我。

sentences.en: I sat down and I read it and I was both stunned and heart-sickened by it.
sentences.zh: 我坐下来读了它，既感到震惊又感到心痛。

sentences.en: So what I found was emails of conversations between top Purdue officials discussing the abuse of OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 我发现的是保真制药高管之间讨论奥施康定滥用情况的电子邮件对话。

sentences.en: What was in the report were recitations of documents that were shared between Purdue executives and members of the Sackler family about the abuse of OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 报告中包含的是保真制药高管与萨克勒家族成员之间关于奥施康定滥用情况的共享文件的摘录。

sentences.en: For example, they were monitoring websites, you know, internet chat rooms that were frequented by drug abusers where they were discussing,
sentences.zh: 例如，他们正在监控网站，你知道的，就是药物滥用者经常光顾的互联网聊天室，他们在那里讨论，

sentences.en: hey, this is this great new drug, you can crush it, you can snort it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，这是一种很棒的新药，你可以把它碾碎，你可以吸食它。

sentences.en: Reports about that were being sent to Richard Sackler, the son of Raymond Sackler, a founder of Purdue Pharma.
sentences.zh: 关于这方面的报告被发送给了理查德·萨克勒，他是保真制药创始人雷蒙德·萨克勒的儿子。

sentences.en: There was this wealth of evidence suggesting that Purdue executives had in fact known about the drug's abuse and I found it just startling.
sentences.zh: 有大量证据表明保真制药高管实际上已经知道了该药物的滥用情况，我发现这太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: And not only the Sacklers knew and not only the executives knew from this evidence, it seems,
sentences.zh: 从这些证据来看，不仅萨克勒家族知道，不仅高管们知道，

sentences.en: but we know the Justice Department knew for more than a decade because it had been in possession of this report.
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道司法部十多年来一直都知道，因为它一直持有这份报告。

sentences.en: And yet the Justice Department decided essentially to do nothing.
sentences.zh: 然而司法部基本上决定什么也不做。

sentences.en: The Justice Department had an opportunity to sound an alarm bell.
sentences.zh: 司法部本有机会敲响警钟。

sentences.en: And all that would have been required was to have gone forward with these recommendations.
sentences.zh: 而所需要做的只是推进这些建议。

sentences.en: And what prosecutors believe is that had they told the truth, this entire marketing campaign, the foundation of OxyContin's marketing campaign would have crumbled.
sentences.zh: 检察官们相信，如果他们说出真相，整个营销活动，也就是奥施康定营销活动的基石就会崩溃。

sentences.en: OxyContin would have been just a niche drug.
sentences.zh: 奥施康定本来只会是一种小众药物。

sentences.en: It would have been a nothing drug.
sentences.zh: 它本会是一种无足轻重的药物。

sentences.en: It would have been just another narcotic painkiller.
sentences.zh: 它本来只会是又一种麻醉止痛药。

sentences.en: But by concealing this information, sales continued to grow and grow and grow and OxyContin became a blockbuster.
sentences.zh: 但通过隐瞒这些信息，销量持续不断地增长，奥施康定成了一款轰动全国的畅销药。

sentences.en: So a decade later, at another moment, the crisis is now the biggest public health epidemic that we're facing.
sentences.zh: 因此，十年后，在另一个时刻，这场危机成了我们面临的最大公共卫生流行病。

sentences.en: And we're lashing out at it in various ways.
sentences.zh: 我们正以各种方式对其进行猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: President Trump recently announced that he favors the execution of drug dealers.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统最近宣布，他赞成处决毒贩。

sentences.en: Attorney General Sessions is calling for a crackdown on doctors and druggists.
sentences.zh: 司法部长塞申斯呼吁严厉打击医生和药剂师。

sentences.en: Some local prosecutors are arresting people found in the same room with people who have overdosed on murder charges, prosecuting them for sharing drugs.
sentences.zh: 一些地方检察官正在以谋杀罪逮捕与用药过量者同处一室的人，以分享毒品的罪名起诉他们。

sentences.en: But we have yet to hold corporate executives to account.
sentences.zh: 但我们尚未追究企业高管的责任。

sentences.en: If we are going to treat street-level drug dealers as criminals,
sentences.zh: 如果我们要把街头毒贩当作罪犯对待，

sentences.en: we have to treat corporate executives who knowingly break the law as criminals as well.
sentences.zh: 我们也必须把明知故犯触犯法律的企业高管当作罪犯对待。

sentences.en: Barry, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 巴里，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Michael, it's been a real pleasure.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这真是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: In June, the Attorney General of Massachusetts filed the first lawsuit against current and former executives of Purdue Pharma, including members of the Sackler family.
sentences.zh: 6月，马萨诸塞州总检察长对保真制药的现任和前任高管（包括萨克勒家族成员）提起了第一起诉讼。

sentences.en: A week later, Purdue Pharma laid off the sales force responsible for marketing OxyContin.
sentences.zh: 一周后，保真制药解雇了负责营销奥施康定的销售团队。

sentences.en: And this week, two members of Congress demanded the release of the sealed report documenting Purdue's deceptive practices
sentences.zh: 本周，两名国会议员要求公开记录保真制药欺骗性做法的被封存报告，

sentences.en: and all communication between the Justice Department and the company related to the last-minute plea deal.
sentences.zh: 以及司法部与该公司就最后一刻认罪协议进行的所有沟通。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人在异乡也能感受到家的温暖的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会喝到断片才能睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
